description: Set or remove ONE top-level YAML frontmatter key on a note, guarded by `expected_digest` from read_note. op:"set" requires `value` to carry EXACTLY ONE of: string, number, bool_value, date (ISO 8601), string_list, or raw_yaml (an escape hatch for a pre-rendered YAML value, e.g. a nested mapping, emitted verbatim). op:"remove" deletes the key; removing an absent key is a no-op (changed:false) rather than an error, and removing the LAST remaining key removes the whole frontmatter block. Every OTHER key — order, comments, unrelated values — is preserved byte-for-byte. REFUSES to change or remove a TaskNotes file's `title` key: that re-mints the task's corpus id, so it must go through update_task. Unlike patch_note_block, frontmatter has no block_id / four-way conflict contract — this is update_note's sibling, guarded by the same simple digest match. dry_run:true reports whether the key would change WITHOUT writing.

dry_run.description:
Preview only — validate the guards + report whether the key would
change WITHOUT writing. The response carries `dry_run: true`.

expected_digest.description:
The `content_digest` from a prior `read_note`. REQUIRED — note-body
writes are always compare-and-swap guarded.

key.description: The top-level frontmatter key to set or remove.

anyOf.description: Exactly ONE of these must be set — the field name IS the type tag.

raw_yaml.description: Escape hatch: pre-rendered YAML value text, emitted verbatim.

string.description:
A string scalar. Quoted on write only if needed to round-trip as a
string (e.g. a numeric-looking value like `"4"`).

string_list.description:
A list of strings, rendered as a YAML block sequence (`key: []`
when empty).

value.description:
The value to set. Required (and exactly one field must be set) when
`op` is `"set"`; ignored for `"remove"`.

name: patch_note_frontmatter
